A TASTE OF OUR HISTORY
OUR LEGACY · SINCE 1916

A century of
coming home.

Kesar Da Dhaba began in 1916 in Sheikhupura, founded by Lala Kesar Mal Ji and his wife. Their small kitchen became known for traditional Punjabi food, cooked slowly and served with care.

During Partition, the family made Amritsar their home, carrying their recipes and traditions with them. Generations later, those same flavours, pure desi ghee and a warm welcome continue at our original address in the old city.
